subject: CFNumberRef<->NSNumber*

observation.summary: Runtime probe creates an NSNumber via @42 and casts it as CFTypeRef; CFGetTypeID() returns 22, identical to CFNumberGetTypeID() (also 22). NSNumber is also observed as a subclass of NSValue via the runtime probe (super: NSValue).
observation.raw_output_excerpt:
NSNumber -> CFNumber: ns=0x10076c110 cf=OK (id match? expected=22 got=22)
=== NSNumber ===
  super: NSValue
=== NSValue ===
  super: NSObject

claim: On this host CFNumberRef is identity-preserved with NSNumber* (and NSNumber inherits from NSValue), confirming the CFNumber<->NSNumber toll-free bridge.
